words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√kṛ

hindi: समान वर्ण वाली और फल को प्राप्त न हुई पर कृत्य करने वाले का हाथ का नाश अथवा चार सौ का दण्ड है।
english: For one who acts upon [a woman] of the same class who has not attained fruit: destruction of the hand, or a fine of four hundred.
notes: prakurvataḥ (pra-√kṛ) is rendered literally 'acts upon'; in this chapter on offences against maidens it is probably the technical verb for violating a maiden, but the text does not say so. aprāpta-phalā is literally 'one who has not attained fruit' (perhaps not yet menstruating; compare ārtava in units 8 and 10). vadha means striking, killing or destruction; with hasta it is rendered 'destruction of the hand' (commonly understood as cutting off). The unit of the fine is not stated (paṇa elsewhere in the chapter). The feminine noun is unnamed; only the adjectives are feminine.

hindi: उसके मर जाने पर वध है।
english: If she has died: death (vadha).
notes: vadha here is the death penalty or killing; the same word is rendered 'destruction' with hasta in unit 1.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√kṛ

hindi: फल को प्राप्त हुई पर कृत्य करने वाले का बीच की उँगली और तर्जनी का नाश अथवा दो सौ का दण्ड है।
english: For one who acts upon [a woman] who has attained fruit: destruction of the middle [finger] and forefinger, or a fine of two hundred.
notes: madhyamā-pradeśinī-vadho is a dvandva (middle and forefinger) followed by vadha. 'Finger' is understood from pradeśinī (the pointing one). See note on unit 1.

hindi: और पिता को कमी दे।
english: And he should give the father the deficiency.
notes: avahīna (diminished, deficient, fallen away) is obscure here; 'the deficiency' is the most literal rendering. It may be the shortfall or loss to the father (bride-price, expenses), but the line does not say. pituḥ is genitive, read as 'to the father' with dā. The subject is not stated.

hindi: और अनिच्छुक पर वह इच्छा की स्वतन्त्रता प्राप्त न करे।
english: And he should not obtain freedom of will with an unwilling [woman].

text_flags.why: doubled b is a probable typo; units 13 and 19 print labheta (3 sg. opt. √labh)

notes: prākāmya (freedom of will, unrestricted action; also used of unrestrained enjoyment) is rendered literally; an alternative is a legal 'right of free enjoyment'. The unnamed feminine noun after akāmāyām is not supplied. 'labbheta' is flagged as a typo of labheta.

hindi: इच्छुक होने पर चौवन पण का दण्ड है, परन्तु स्त्री का आधा दण्ड है।
english: When she is willing, a fine of fifty-four paṇas; but the woman's [fine is] a half fine.
notes: catuṣ-pañcāśat is 'four and fifty' = 54. Who pays the 54 is not stated (the man, by context); the woman's fine is half.

words.gloss: when she is held by another's bride-price

hindi: दूसरे के शुल्क से रोकी हुई पर हाथ का नाश अथवा चार सौ का दण्ड और शुल्क का देना है।
english: When she is held by another's bride-price: destruction of the hand, or a fine of four hundred, and the giving of the bride-price.
notes: śulka is rendered 'bride-price' from the context of the chapter (śulka also means fee or toll). avaruddha (confined, held, secured) is rendered 'held'; the sense is probably 'already secured by the bride-price of another'. The unnamed feminine noun is not supplied.

words.gloss: one in whom seven ārtavas have arisen

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. ātm. √labh

hindi: वरण के बाद जिसके सात आर्तव उत्पन्न हो चुके हैं उसे न पाता हुआ, उस पर कृत्य करके, इच्छा की स्वतन्त्रता वाला हो सकता है, और पिता को कमी न दे।
english: Not obtaining, after the betrothal, her in whom seven ārtavas (menstrual periods) have arisen, having acted upon [her] he may be one with freedom of will; and he should not give the father the deficiency.
notes: sapta-ārtava-prajātā is read as a bahuvrīhi, 'one in whom seven ārtavas have arisen' (ārtava = relating to the season, i.e. the menstrual period; compare unit 10); an alternative is 'one who has been through seven ārtavas'. prakṛtya could be read as the same verb as in units 1 and 3. The referents of the subject and of 'her' are not stated. See notes on units 4 and 5 for avahīna and prākāmya.

hindi: ऋतु को रोकने वालों के द्वारा स्वामित्व से हट जाता है।
english: [One] withdraws from ownership through those who obstruct the ṛtu (menstrual period).
notes: Obscure. The subject of apakrāmati is not stated. ṛtu-pratirodhin is read literally as an agent noun in the instrumental plural ('those obstructing the ṛtu'); it could also mean 'obstructions of the ṛtu' or the instrumental could be causal ('on account of'). svāmya (lordship, ownership) is taken as the right of the husband or master.

words.gloss: of one whose ārtava arose three years ago

hindi: जिसके आर्तव को उत्पन्न हुए तीन वर्ष हो चुके हैं उसके पास जाने में समान पुरुष निर्दोष है; उसके बाद बिना सजी हुई के पास असमान भी निर्दोष है।
english: An equal [man] is without fault in going to her whose ārtava arose three years ago; after that, even an unequal [man] [is without fault in going] to one who is unadorned.
notes: The second half supplies the predicate and 'going to' from the first half (shown in brackets in English). tulya is 'equal' (in class), a-tulya 'unequal'. tataḥ param is 'after that [period]'. The genitives are read with gantum ('in going to her').

hindi: पिता के धन को लेने में वह चोरी का भागी हो।
english: In taking the father's property he would incur theft.
notes: dravya is rendered 'property'. bhaj is 'share in, partake of, incur'; the subject is unstated. pitṛ could also be read 'fathers'.

hindi: दूसरे को निर्दिष्ट करके दूसरे का पाने वाले का दो सौ का दण्ड है।
english: For one who, having designated another, obtains [one] of another: a fine of two hundred.
notes: Obscure. The object of vindataḥ and the sense of param uddiśya anyasya are not clear; the literal rendering leaves them open. Possibly the sense is obtaining a maiden after pointing to one man but giving her to another, as in unit 14, but the text does not say so.

hindi: और अनिच्छुक पर वह इच्छा की स्वतन्त्रता प्राप्त न करे।
english: And he should not obtain freedom of will with an unwilling [woman].

text_flags.why: anusvāra for m; the word is prākāmya (units 5 and 8 print prākāmyam, prākāmī)

notes: prākāmya (freedom of will, unrestricted action; also used of unrestrained enjoyment) is rendered literally; an alternative is a legal 'right of free enjoyment'. The unnamed feminine noun after akāmāyām is not supplied. 'prākāṃyam' is flagged as a typo of prākāmyam.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√dā

words.gloss: in the case of an equal [one]
in the case of an inferior [one]

hindi: एक कन्या को दिखाकर दूसरी को देने वाले का समान के विषय में सौ का दण्ड है, हीन के विषय में दुगुना।
english: For one who, having shown one maiden, gives another: a fine of a hundred in the case of an equal [one], double in the case of an inferior [one].
notes: kanyām anyām ... anyām is read 'one maiden ... another'. śatya is a taddhita adjective, 'of a hundred'. tulyā and hīnā are taken as 'equal' and 'inferior' to the one shown; the text does not say in what respect.

hindi: अकुमारी पर प्रकर्म में चौवन पण का दण्ड है, और शुल्क का व्यय और कर्म वह लौटा दे।
english: In acting upon a non-maiden: a fine of fifty-four paṇas; and he should give back the bride-price expenditure and the action.
notes: prakarman (pra-karman, 'acting upon', related to prakurvataḥ of unit 1) is rendered literally. śulka-vyaya-karmaṇī is a dual dvandva: the two members are probably (śulka-vyaya) and karman, i.e. the expenditure on the bride-price and the action (perhaps a ceremony or work); the sense of karman is uncertain. Unit 18 has the same pair. The subject of pratidadyāt is not stated.

hindi: रहकर उससे उत्पन्न को, बाद में की गई वह दुगुना दे।
english: Having remained [with] what is born of that, she who was made afterwards should give double.
notes: Obscure; no firm reading. ava-√sthā has many senses (remain, settle upon, wait); taj-jāta (born of that, or of that kind) and paścāt-kṛtā (made afterwards, put behind) are rendered literally. The object of avasthāya and the referent of 'that' are not stated. Do not build on this reading.

hindi: दूसरे के रक्त को रखने में दो सौ का दण्ड है, और झूठा आरोप लगाने वाले पुरुष का भी।
english: In putting another's blood: a fine of two hundred; and [likewise] of a man who accuses falsely.

text_flags.why: possible: the compound mark '.' is missing here, while dvi.śato is printed elsewhere (units 3, 12, 24)

notes: upadhāna is 'placing near, putting under'; the object and place are not stated. The second part is read as the fine of two hundred (understood) for a man who falsely accuses; 'likewise' is supplied. The purpose (simulating the signs of a maiden) is not stated in the text.

hindi: और शुल्क का व्यय और कर्म वह खो दे।
english: And he should lose the bride-price expenditure and the action.
notes: Same pair as unit 15 (see note there). jīyeta is the optative passive of √jyā (be deprived of, lose) or √ji; the sense 'forfeit' is read. The subject is not stated.

hindi: और अनिच्छुक पर वह इच्छा की स्वतन्त्रता प्राप्त न करे।
english: And he should not obtain freedom of will with an unwilling [woman].

text_flags.why: anusvāra for m; the word is prākāmya (units 5 and 8 print prākāmyam, prākāmī)

notes: prākāmya (freedom of will, unrestricted action; also used of unrestrained enjoyment) is rendered literally; an alternative is a legal 'right of free enjoyment'. The unnamed feminine noun after akāmāyām is not supplied. 'prākāṃyam' is flagged as a typo of prākāmyam. The line is identical to unit 13.

words.gloss: one acted upon by a woman

hindi: स्त्री के द्वारा जिस पर कृत्य किया गया वह इच्छुक और समान हो तो बारह पण का दण्ड दे, कर्ता स्त्री दुगुना।
english: One acted upon by a woman, if willing and equal, should pay a fine of twelve paṇas; the female doer, double.
notes: strī-prakṛtā is read as 'acted upon by a woman' (instrumental tat-puruṣa); the alternative 'a woman who has been acted upon' does not fit prakartrī. samānā is rendered 'equal' (in class, or to the doer); the text does not say.

words.gloss: for the sake of one's own passion
words.gram: n. acc. sg. used as adv.

hindi: अनिच्छुक के विषय में अपने राग के लिए सौ का दण्ड है, और शुल्क का देना।
english: In the case of an unwilling [woman]: a fine of a hundred, for the sake of one's own passion, and the giving of the bride-price.
notes: The genitive akāmāyāḥ is read 'in the case of an unwilling [woman]'. The person fined (presumably the doer of unit 20) is not stated.

hindi: जिस पर स्वयं कृत्य किया गया हो वह राजा की दासता में जाए।
english: One acted upon by herself should go into the king's servitude.
notes: svayaṃ prakṛtā is read literally as 'acted upon by herself' (self-done, as against strī-prakṛtā in unit 20). dāsya is the state of a slave.

words.gloss: in the case of one acted upon

hindi: गाँव के बाहर के स्थान में जिस पर कृत्य किया गया उसके विषय में और झूठे आरोप में दुगुना दण्ड है।
english: In the case of one acted upon outside the village, and in false accusation: a double fine.
notes: bahir-grāmasya is read as bahis (outside) + grāma with the genitive ending on the second member; the genitive is unusual (a locative or ablative would be expected), so the sense 'outside the village' is a reading. The case is not flagged as a typo.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. apa-√hṛ

hindi: बलपूर्वक कन्या का हरण करने वाले का दो सौ का दण्ड है; सोने सहित का सबसे ऊँचा।
english: For one who, by force, carries off a maiden: [a fine] of two hundred; [if she is] together with gold, the highest [fine].
notes: The nouns 'fine' (after dviśataḥ and uttamaḥ) are supplied from the context (daṇḍa in neighbouring units). 'The highest' presumably refers to the highest grade of fine; the text does not say. sa-suvarṇām could also be read 'with gold [on her]'.

hindi: कन्या का हरण करने वाले बहुतों के अलग-अलग दण्ड कहे अनुसार हैं।
english: Of many carriers-off of a maiden, the fines are separate, as stated.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√kṛ

hindi: गणिका की पुत्री पर कृत्य करने वाले का चौवन पण का दण्ड है; शुल्क माता का भोग सोलह गुना।
english: For one who acts upon the daughter of a courtesan: a fine of fifty-four paṇas; the bride-price [is] the mother's enjoyment (bhoga), sixteenfold.
notes: bhoga is taken literally as 'enjoyment' (it can also mean income or revenue); mātur bhogaḥ may mean the mother's income or earnings, and sixteenfold applies to that. The grammar of the second half is elliptical; no verb is stated.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√kṛ

hindi: दास या दासी की पुत्री, अदासी पर कृत्य करने वाले का चौबीस पण का दण्ड है, और शुल्क और आबन्ध्य का देना।
english: For one who acts upon the daughter of a slave or a female slave, a non-slave woman: a fine of twenty-four paṇas, and the giving of the bride-price and ābandhya.
notes: ābandhya (what is bound on; possibly ornaments) is obscure and left untranslated. adāsīm is read as an apposition, 'a non-slave woman'; it may also mean 'treating her as a non-slave'. dāsyā is dāsyāḥ before vā.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√kṛ

hindi: निष्क्रय के अनुरूप दासी पर कृत्य करने वाले का बारह पण का दण्ड है, और वस्त्र और आबन्ध्य का देना।
english: For one who acts upon a female slave in accord with the ransom: a fine of twelve paṇas, and the giving of cloth and ābandhya.
notes: niṣkraya (ransom, redemption price) and anurūpa (corresponding, suitable) are rendered literally; the sense (a slave woman acted upon as the ransom permits, or a price matching her) is not clear. ābandhya is left untranslated as in unit 27.

hindi: सहायता का अवसर देने में कर्ता के समान दण्ड है।
english: In giving opportunity for assistance: a fine equal to the doer's.
notes: sācivya is the state of being a companion or minister, hence assistance; avakāśa is room or opportunity.

words.gram: f. acc. sg. pres. part. apa-√car

hindi: जिसका पति प्रवास में है, भटकती हुई उसे पति का बन्धु अथवा उसका पुरुष पकड़ ले।
english: The husband's kinsman or his man should seize a woman whose husband is away, who goes wrong.
notes: apa-√car is 'go away, behave wrongly'; the offence is not named. tat-puruṣa here is simply 'his man' (not the grammatical term).

hindi: पकड़ी गई वह पति की प्रतीक्षा करे।
english: One seized should expect [her] husband.
notes: ā-√kāṅkṣ is 'wish for, expect, await'; 'await his decision' is the likely sense but the text does not say.

hindi: यदि पति क्षमा करे तो दोनों छोड़ दिए जाएँ।
english: If the husband should forgive, both should be released.
notes: ubhayam (neuter, 'both') is read as the woman and the man she was seized with; the text does not name them.

words.gloss: cutting off of ears and nose

hindi: क्षमा न होने पर स्त्री के कान और नाक का काटना है, और जार वध को प्राप्त करे।
english: When there is no forbearance: the cutting off of the woman's ears and nose; and the paramour should incur death.
notes: akṣamāyām is read as the locative of the noun kṣamā with a-, 'when there is no forbearance' (the husband's); a feminine adjective 'in one who is intolerant' is less likely. jāra is rendered 'paramour'.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. abhi-√hṛ

hindi: जार को “चोर” कहकर ले जाने वाले का पाँच सौ का दण्ड है; धन लेकर छोड़ने वाले का उसका आठ गुना।
english: For one who carries off a paramour, [calling him] “thief”: a fine of five hundred; for one who releases [him] for money: eight times that.
notes: The quotation “thief” is closed by iti, which is not rendered; 'calling him' is supplied. abhi-√hṛ is 'carry off, seize'. hiraṇya is rendered 'money', as in 5.2. The construction is elliptical; the second part has no stated object.

hindi: बाल पकड़कर आपस में खींचने से पकड़ना है, अथवा शरीर के उपभोगों के चिह्न से, उससे उत्पन्न हुओं से, अथवा स्त्री के कथन से।
english: Seizing [is established] by hair-to-hair [grappling], or from the indication of bodily enjoyments, from those born of that, or from a woman's statement.

text_flags.why: possible: the editors themselves print '(taj.jñātebhyaḥ? cf. N12.60)' as a doubted variant

notes: The printed text carries the editors' own doubt mark: the variant taj.jñātebhyaḥ 'from those who know it', with the reference N12.60. The printed reading taj.jātebhyaḥ is translated; the variant is not applied. keśākeśika is taken as 'by [mutual] seizing of hair' (as a way of establishing the arrest). upaliṅgana is rendered 'indication' (literal sense uncertain). The predicate '[is established]' is supplied; the list reads as grounds for seizing.

words.gloss: carried off by enemy troops or forest tribes
words.gram: f. acc. sg., dvandva in tat-puruṣa

words.gloss: given up in the state of the deceased

hindi: शत्रु की सेना या वन की जातियों द्वारा हरी गई, बाढ़ में बही हुई, वनों में या अकाल में त्यागी गई, अथवा मृतक की अवस्था में छोड़ी गई पराई स्त्री को बचाकर वह जैसा बातचीत में तय हुआ उसके अनुसार उसका उपभोग करे।
english: Having rescued another's woman—carried off by enemy troops or forest tribes, swept away by a flood, abandoned in forests or in famine, or given up in the state of the deceased—he may enjoy her as agreed.
notes: aṭavī is read as 'forest tribes', as an agent beside para-cakra (compare the force sense in 8.1); 'forests' (the place) is the alternative. preta-bhāva-utsṛṣṭā is literal ('released in the state of the deceased', i.e. given up as dead); the exact sense is not given. yathā-sambhāṣitam is 'as spoken together', rendered 'as agreed'. The subject of samupabhuñjīta is not stated ('he').

hindi: जाति में श्रेष्ठ, अनिच्छुक, सन्तान वाली को निष्क्रय देकर दे।
english: One excelling in birth, unwilling, or having offspring: he should give [her] for a ransom.
notes: dadyāt has no stated object but the accusatives; 'give [her] for a ransom' is literal, probably 'give her back' (compare unit 40 apavāhayet). jāti-viśiṣṭā is 'excelling in birth' (class); the three descriptions may be alternatives or all apply.

words.gloss: from the current of a river
from the disorder of the region

hindi: चोरों के हाथों से, नदी के वेग से, अकाल से, देश के विक्षोभ से, वनों से बचाकर—खोई हुई, त्यागी हुई, अथवा “मृत”—
english: Having rescued [a woman] from the hands of thieves, from the current of a river, from famine, from the disorder of the region, from wildernesses—one lost, abandoned, or [taken as] “dead”—
notes: The sentence continues in unit 39. The woman is unnamed (feminine accusatives only). kāntārān is kāntārāt (ablative), read as a plural 'wildernesses'; the number is uncertain. The phrase “mṛtā” is quoted; iti is not rendered.

hindi: दूसरों की स्त्री का पुरुष जैसा बातचीत में तय हुआ उसके अनुसार उपभोग करे, परन्तु राजा के प्रताप से या अपने जनों से छुड़ाई गई का नहीं।
english: A man may enjoy the woman of others as agreed, but not one released by the king's might or by [her] own people.
notes: Continues unit 38. svajana is 'one's own people'; whose is not stated ('her' is read). pratāpa is 'might, majesty'. The verse repeats the rule of unit 36.

hindi: उच्चतम को नहीं, अनिच्छुक को नहीं और पहले से सन्तान वाली को नहीं; ऐसी को तो अनुरूप निष्क्रय देकर हटवा दे।
english: [He should enjoy] neither the highest, nor an unwilling one, nor one with earlier offspring; but such a one he should have carried away with a suitable ransom.
notes: The verb '[he should enjoy]' is supplied from unit 39 for the three negatives; uttamā is 'the highest' (probably of the highest class; compare jāti-viśiṣṭā in unit 37). apavāhayet (caus. apa-√vah) is rendered literally 'have carried away' (send away). The object is not stated.
